newsitem.title: UK: GKN shares tumble after lawsuit report.
newsitem.headline: GKN shares tumble after lawsuit report.

text.p: Shares in GKN Plc were marked sharply lower in pre-market trading on Monday after a report in the Financial Times newspaper said the engineering group faced a sharply increased damages claim in a U.S. lawsuit.
The stock was down 35p at 960 by 0815 GMT.

The FT report said lawyers seeking compensation from GKN were this week expected to file for more than $740 million stg, more than double last December's $347 million award by a U.S. jury against GKN for allegedly defrauding franchisees of its specialist exhaust retail chain.
Nobody at GKN was immediately available to comment.
In December, GKN shares tumbled when the damages were awarded against the company. GKN said at the time that the damages could be increased to $554 million.
The Financial Times said that if damages were increased to $741 million, GKN's cash reserves would be almost wiped out and it would have to announce one-off provisions.
The newspaper said some analysts were predicting a share price fall of 75 to 100p if the damages were increased.
